#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    char first_char = s.front();
    s.erase(0, 1);
    
    size_t at_pos = s.find("at");
    if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
        s.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
    }
    
    while (true) {
        size_t dot_pos = s.find("dot");
        if (dot_pos == std::string::npos || dot_pos == s.length() - 3) {
            break;
        }
        s.replace(dot_pos, 3, ".");
    }
    
    std::cout << first_char << s;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    std::string result = "";
    result += s[0];
    
    std::string rest = s.substr(1);
    
    // Replace first "at"
    size_t at_pos = rest.find("at");
    if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
        rest = rest.substr(0, at_pos) + "@" + rest.substr(at_pos + 2);
    }
    
    // Replace all "dot" except at the end
    while (true) {
        size_t dot_pos = rest.find("dot");
        if (dot_pos == std::string::npos || dot_pos == rest.length() - 3) break;
        rest = rest.substr(0, dot_pos) + "." + rest.substr(dot_pos + 3);
    }
    
    std::cout << result << rest;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    char first = s[0];
    std::string t = s.substr(1);
    
    // Replace first "at" occurrence
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < t.length(); ++i) {
        if (t[i] == 'a' && t[i+1] == 't') {
            t[i] = '@';
            t.erase(i+1, 1);
            break;
        }
    }
    
    // Replace all "dot" except at the end
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 2 < t.length(); ++i) {
        while (i + 2 < t.length() && t[i] == 'd' && t[i+1] == 'o' && t[i+2] == 't') {
            if (i + 3 == t.length()) break;
            t[i] = '.';
            t.erase(i+1, 3);
            break;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << first << t;
    return 0;
}
